ja: この薬を飲み始めてから発疹が出てきたので、別の薬に変えられないか先生に確認してもらえますか？
en: I've broken out in a rash since I started taking this, so could you check with the doctor about switching me to something else?
alternatives: I've come out in a rash since I started this medicine, so could you ask the doctor whether I can switch to something else?
Since I started taking this, I've broken out in a rash, so could you check with the doctor if I can change to a different medicine?
point: 発疹が出るは break out in a rash、確認するは check with

ja: 先生、私は咳が出て、のどが痛いです。
en: I have a cough and a sore throat.
alternatives: I've got a cough and a sore throat.
I have a cough, and my throat hurts.
point: 咳は a cough と数えられる名詞で表す

ja: 今日休めるなら病院に行くんですけど、大事な会議があって抜けられないんです。
en: If I could take the day off, I'd go see a doctor, but I've got an important meeting I can't miss.
alternatives: If I could take today off, I'd go to the doctor, but there's an important meeting I can't skip.
I'd go see a doctor if I could take the day off, but I have an important meeting I can't miss.
point: 今の事実に反する仮定は If I could 〜, I'd 〜 と過去形で

ja: この薬を処方される前に、先生にアレルギーのことを伝えておけばよかった。
en: I wish I'd told the doctor about my allergy before I was prescribed this medicine.
alternatives: If only I'd told the doctor about my allergy before I was prescribed this medicine.
I should have mentioned my allergy to the doctor before I was prescribed this medicine.
point: 過去の後悔は I wish の後を過去完了にする

ja: 夫は胸の痛みなんて大したことないと言い張るけど、明日は絶対に検査を受けさせます。
en: My husband keeps insisting his chest pain is nothing, but I'm definitely making him get it checked tomorrow.
alternatives: My husband keeps saying his chest pain is nothing, but I'll make him have it checked tomorrow.
My husband insists his chest pain is nothing, but I'm definitely making him get it looked at tomorrow.
point: 嫌がる相手にさせるのは make him do、get it checked の形も

ja: 近くに薬局はありますか？
en: Is there a pharmacy near here?
alternatives: Is there a drugstore nearby?
Is there a pharmacy nearby?
point: 「ありますか」は Is there ～? で聞く

ja: 念のためお聞きしますが、これまでにこの種類の薬で副作用が出たことはありますか？
en: Just to check, have you ever had any side effects from this kind of medicine?
alternatives: Just to make sure, have you ever had side effects from this type of medicine?
Can I just ask, have you ever had side effects from this kind of medicine?
point: 経験を聞くので Have you ever had、「〜で」は from

ja: 一晩中高熱が続いたので、彼女は朝一番に近くのクリニックに行きました。
en: Having had a high fever all night, she went to a nearby clinic first thing in the morning.
alternatives: Since she'd had a high fever all night, she went to a nearby clinic first thing in the morning.
After having a high fever all night, she went to a local clinic first thing in the morning.
point: 先に続いた状態は Having had で理由として前に置く

ja: この薬を飲んでいる間は、お酒を飲むのを避けたほうがいいですか？
en: Should I avoid drinking alcohol while I'm taking this medicine?
alternatives: Do I need to avoid drinking alcohol while I'm on this medication?
Is it better to avoid drinking alcohol while I'm taking this medicine?
point: avoid の後は to 不定詞でなく drinking と動名詞

ja: 先月ちゃんと健康診断を受けていたら、彼は今ごろ入院なんてしていなかったはずだよ。
en: If he had gotten a checkup last month, he wouldn't be in the hospital right now.
alternatives: If he'd had a checkup last month, he wouldn't be in the hospital now.
If he'd gone in for a checkup last month, he wouldn't be in the hospital now.
point: 過去の仮定は had gotten、今の結果は wouldn't be

ja: この薬を3日間飲んでいるんですが、前より頭痛がひどくなった気がします。
en: I've been taking this medicine for three days, but I feel like my headaches are worse than before.
alternatives: I've been on this medicine for three days, but I think my headaches are worse than before.
I've taken this medicine for three days, but my headaches feel worse than they did before.
point: 「前より」は worse than before、3日間は現在完了進行形で

ja: 昨日、薬剤師さんが飲み合わせに気づいてくれていなかったら、妻はもっとひどい副作用が出ていたかもしれません。
en: If the pharmacist hadn't noticed the drug interaction yesterday, my wife might have had a much more serious reaction.
alternatives: If the pharmacist hadn't caught the drug interaction yesterday, my wife could have had a far worse side effect.
Had the pharmacist not noticed the interaction yesterday, my wife might have had much worse side effects.
point: 過去の事実の反対は hadn't noticed と might have had

ja: 兄は今日の午後、病院で診てもらうことになってるよ。
en: My brother is seeing a doctor this afternoon.
alternatives: My brother is going to see a doctor this afternoon.
My brother has a doctor's appointment this afternoon.
point: 決まった予定は進行形 is seeing で表せる

ja: 2日前からずっと咳が止まらないんです。
en: I've been coughing nonstop for two days.
alternatives: I've been coughing for two days straight.
I've been coughing constantly for the past two days.
point: 今も続いている症状は I've been ＋ -ing ＋ for で言う

ja: すみません、この薬を飲むと眠くなるかどうか、教えていただけないかと思いまして。
en: Excuse me, I was wondering if you could tell me whether this medicine will make me drowsy.
alternatives: Excuse me, I was wondering whether you could tell me if this medicine will make me sleepy.
Sorry, I was wondering if you could let me know whether this medication causes drowsiness.
point: 過去進行形 was wondering で丁寧に。中身は whether 節

ja: この薬は食後に飲むように言われたんですが、朝ごはんを抜いた日はどうすればいいですか？
en: I was told to take this medicine after meals, but what should I do on days when I skip breakfast?
alternatives: I was told to take this medicine after eating, but what should I do if I skip breakfast?
I've been told to take this after meals, so what should I do on days I skip breakfast?
point: 言われた は I was told to do の受け身で言う

ja: 先生、私が本当に知りたいのは、この痛みが手術しなくても治るかどうかなんです。
en: Doctor, what I really want to know is whether this pain will get better without surgery.
alternatives: Doctor, what I really want to know is if this pain will go away without an operation.
Doctor, the thing I really want to know is whether this pain will go away without surgery.
point: 「〜かどうか」は whether で、語順は平叙文のまま

ja: 昨日教えてもらった、眠くならない花粉症の薬って、まだありますか？
en: Do you still have the allergy medicine you told me about yesterday, the one that doesn't make you drowsy?
alternatives: Do you still have that non-drowsy allergy medicine you told me about yesterday?
Do you still have the non-drowsy allergy medicine you mentioned yesterday?
point: medicine の後ろに you told me about を置き、the one that 〜 で補足する

ja: 昨日の夜に食べた牡蠣にあたったのかもしれないって、お医者さんに言われました。
en: The doctor said I might have gotten food poisoning from the oysters I ate last night.
alternatives: The doctor told me I might have gotten food poisoning from the oysters I had last night.
According to the doctor, I might have gotten sick from the oysters I ate last night.
point: 過去の推量は might have + 過去分詞

ja: 熱があるなら、今日は家で休んでね。
en: Stay home today if you have a fever.
alternatives: If you have a fever, stay home today.
Rest at home today if you have a fever.
point: 「熱がある」は have a fever、a を忘れずに

ja: 医者に出してもらった薬と一緒に、この風邪薬を飲んでも大丈夫ですか？
en: Is it okay to take this cold medicine with the pills prescribed by my doctor?
alternatives: Can I take this cold medicine with the medicine my doctor prescribed?
Is it safe to take this cold medicine with the pills my doctor prescribed?
Is it okay to take this cold medicine with what my doctor prescribed?
point: 「医者に出してもらった薬」は pills prescribed by my doctor と後ろから修飾

ja: 今、ほかに何か薬を飲んでいますか？
en: Are you taking any other medicine now?
alternatives: Are you currently taking any other medication?
Are you on any other medicine right now?
point: 薬を「飲む」は drink ではなく take

ja: 妹は熱が38度もあるのに、明日の試験は絶対に受けると言い張っています。
en: Even though my sister has a fever of 38 degrees, she insists she's going to take tomorrow's exam no matter what.
alternatives: Although my sister has a 38-degree fever, she's insisting that she'll take tomorrow's exam no matter what.
My sister has a fever of 38 degrees, but she insists on taking tomorrow's exam no matter what.
point: 「〜のに」は even though で前に出す

ja: 私が病院に着いた頃には、熱はもう下がっていました。
en: By the time I got to the hospital, my fever had already gone down.
alternatives: When I got to the hospital, my fever had already gone down.
My fever had already come down by the time I reached the hospital.
point: 着いた時点より前に下がったので had gone down と過去完了

ja: 痛みがほとんどなくなったとしても、処方された抗生物質は最後まで飲み切ったほうがいいですか？
en: Even if the pain has mostly gone away, should I still finish all the antibiotics I was prescribed?
alternatives: Even if the pain is mostly gone, should I still take all of the antibiotics I was prescribed?
Should I still finish the whole course of antibiotics even if the pain has pretty much gone away?
point: 「〜としても」は even if、主節に still を添える

ja: 息子は熱が出ただけじゃなくて、夜中に何度も吐いたんです。
en: Not only did my son have a fever, but he also threw up several times during the night.
alternatives: Not only did my son run a fever, but he also vomited several times in the night.
My son not only had a fever but also threw up several times during the night.
point: Not only が文頭なら did my son have の疑問文語順

ja: かかりつけの先生が週末も診てくれたらいいのに。息子の熱が昨日から下がらないんです。
en: I wish our family doctor saw patients on weekends. My son's fever hasn't gone down since yesterday.
alternatives: If only our family doctor saw patients on weekends. My son's fever hasn't gone down since yesterday.
I wish our family doctor worked weekends. My son's fever hasn't come down since yesterday.
point: 今の願望は wish + 過去形。熱は現在完了で hasn't gone down

ja: 私が心配なのは頭痛じゃなくて、ここ数日、毎朝めまいがすることなんです。
en: What worries me isn't the headache, it's the dizziness I've been getting every morning for the past few days.
alternatives: It's not the headache that worries me, it's the dizziness I've been having every morning for the last few days.
The headache isn't what worries me; it's that I've been feeling dizzy every morning for the past few days.
point: 「心配なのは〜」は What worries me is で始めて強調する

ja: 昨日の夜は熱が出て、全然眠れなかったんです。
en: I had a fever and couldn't sleep at all last night.
alternatives: I had a fever last night, so I couldn't sleep at all.
I couldn't sleep at all last night because of a fever.
point: 「熱が出た」は have の過去形で had a fever

ja: お医者さんに、薬を飲んだら少なくとも一日は安静にしてって言われたの。
en: The doctor told me I should rest for at least a day after taking the medicine.
alternatives: The doctor said I should rest for at least a day after taking the medicine.
The doctor said I needed to rest for at least a day after I took the medicine.
point: 言われた内容は told me の後に I should で続ける
